title: Certified-Renovator Labor in the Insurance Claim Services Regulated-Scope Supplement
content:
**Compliance basis.** The certified-renovator labor is taken as follows: for housing (a single-family house, condominium unit or multifamily unit) built before the water job tier's RRP year-built cutoff, the supervisor labor billed on the service date of the job's latest containment setup line, because the Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule requires a certified renovator to set up or direct the containment of the work area; for a commercial property built before the tier's asbestos sampling year cutoff, the technician and supervisor labor billed on that date, because the asbestos NESHAP work practices govern the whole crew's sealing of the area before tear-out; otherwise no renovator labor.

This rule belongs to the regulated-scope supplement of Insurance Claim Services. The property type, year built and labor lines are those recorded and billed on the Water Damage Mitigation job.

## Figures the rule turns on

- RRP year-built cutoff: 1978 on every Water Damage Mitigation tier (built 1977 or earlier is before it).
- Asbestos sampling year cutoff: 1981 on every Water Damage Mitigation tier (built 1980 or earlier is before it).
- The date: the service date of the latest containment setup line billed on the job. Where the job billed no containment setup line there is no such date, and no labor is taken.

## By property

| Property type | Year built | Labor taken on the latest containment setup date |
|---|---|---|
| single-family house, condominium unit or multifamily unit | 1977 or earlier | the supervisor labor billed |
| single-family house, condominium unit or multifamily unit | 1978 or later | none |
| commercial property | 1980 or earlier | the technician and supervisor labor billed |
| commercial property | 1981 or later | none |

*Hypothetical:* a condominium unit built in 1971 whose latest containment setup line is dated 9 April, with supervisor labor of 236.00 and technician labor of 412.00 billed that day, takes 236.00. A commercial property built in 1979 with the same lines takes 648.00.
